Explain how a VPN works in simple words
8:53 AM

A VPN is a private tunnel between your device and another computer on the internet, and all your traffic goes through it.

Normally, websites see your address and your internet provider can see where you go. With a VPN, your data is locked before it leaves your device, travels through the tunnel to the VPN's computer, and only then goes out to the website. The site sees the VPN's address, not yours, and your provider sees only scrambled data.

It helps on public Wi-Fi and hides your location from websites. It does not make you anonymous, because the VPN company can still see your activity, so pick one you trust.
